definitions.full: H2299. chad II. חַד see below חדד . II. [ חַד ] adjective sharp — only feminine singular חַדָּה , of חֶרֶב Ezek 5:1 ; in figure of tongue Psa 57:5 ; simile of mouth Isa 49:2 ; figurative of end of (i.e. final experience with) strange woman ׳ח פִיּוֺת כְּחֶרֶב Prov 5:4 (|| כַלַּעֲנָה מָרָ֯ה ). — 1. חַד see below אֶחָד . חַדָּה see חַדָּה עֵין .

occurrences.englishText: Be exalted, God, above the heavens!
but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood,
He has made my mouth like a sharp sword.

“You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.
